name: Golden Hand
about: A talking-head list kit: a gold blackletter hook title with glowing skill tiles; a moss-stone hand that rises over the speaker holding a dial with a white bevelled star, the chapters gathering round it in blackletter as the dial turns; a dark starry ground for top panels (a Master File folder with a cursor click, bullet lists with software chips, website cards, a premium-pricing text card, bad-vs-good thumbnail cards with hand labels, an icon flow, people icons, a mind-map that draws its branches); a phone b-roll with stacked words; a black comment card. Learned from reference r3, built with ishaan-motion.
sound: kits/motion/sfx.js: the engine sfx map by event (card-in, scene, stat, list-item, click-ui, pop, key-word, cascade, hard-hit, cta), added only where the reference has no hit
